Doringkloof - Bushcamp 4x4
Here, in the heart of the Baviaanskloof, Doringkloof offers various accommodation options and recreational activities. Our accommodation options include a shady grassed Bush Camp and 4 self catering Chalets.
Please follow the links to read more about what Doringkloof in the Baviaanskloof has to offer.
We also have 4 4 routes with varying difficulty levels and all with awesome views of the Baviaanskloof and Kouga Mountains and Valleys.
Please note that telephone lines in the area are not reliable and the best way to book is via WhatsApp.

Baviaanskloof Self Catering Accommodation - Doringkloof 4x4 & Bush Camp
Skip to content
Doringkloof Self Catering Cottages
Doringkloof - Baviaanskloof Self Catering Accommodation
To one side of the camping area, tucked among the trees and with peaceful views across the dam are three neat wooden chalets.
Chalets 1 and 2 has a double bed and can sleep two people, with an en-suite shower, toilet and hand basin.
Each chalet also comes with a kitchenette equipped with all the necessities for a self-catering stay.
Chalet 3 has a single bed in the living area, a bedroom with a double bed and another room with 3 single beds.
A total of 6 people can be accommodated in chalet 3.
These chalets represent the ideal alternative for a couple seeking an economical place to stay in the Baviaanskloof without the need for camping equipment.
Just bring your food and yourselves!
